description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' that subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM application. It handles events related to changing the status of the 'buzz' module, updating permissions for associated dashboard widgets accordingly.

classes.name: BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to module status change events, specifically for the 'buzz' module, and updates dashboard widget permissions when the module's status changes.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to, with corresponding callback methods.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event; updates widget permissions if the 'buzz' module's status changes.
